product_family: AI-native ATS and CRM platform for recruitment and staffing agencies; sub-products include AIRA (AI agent suite with Notetaker, Matchmaker, Field Updates Agent, Submission Agent, Task Agent), multichannel sequences, workflow automation, and Recruiterflow BI

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: We are now super happy to announce that Recruiterflow is SOC 2 Type 1 and ISO 27001 certified. With this, we meet the highest standards for security and data protection, ensuring your information is safe with us.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Only SOC 2 Type 1 is confirmed per the May 2024 announcement and DPA badge (which shows 'AICPA SOC 2' without a Type qualifier). No public evidence of Type 2 audit completion.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: We are now super happy to announce that Recruiterflow is SOC 2 Type 1 and ISO 27001 certified. ISO 27001 Certified badge displayed on the Data Processing Agreement page.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: DPA incorporates Standard Contractual Clauses (EU) 2021/914 and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum. User is the Controller of Personal Data and Recruiterflow is the Processor of that data.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not mentioned in DPA, privacy policy, product pages, or blog announcements.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: unknown / no public evidence. Recruiterflow markets AI-native capabilities (AIRA) but no AI governance certification found.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: unknown / no public evidence. Product targets private-sector recruiting agencies, not US federal government.

privacy.ai_training_note: Public marketing materials state AIRA operates on 'client-specific datasets only' with 'no cross-account training or shared memory' and 'no data ever leaves the system,' but these commitments are not confirmed in the publicly accessible privacy policy or DPA text. AI training posture is not explicitly addressed in the DPA or user agreement. Prospective customers should request a written AI data usage commitment before contracting.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly disclosed. DPA references EU and UK data protection law and includes SCCs but does not specify processing locations or data center regions.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not explicitly stated in public documentation; implied by ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 1 compliance. No specific TLS version or cipher suite published.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Not explicitly stated in public documentation; implied by ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 1 compliance. No AES specification published.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based permissions available. DPA references physical and logical access controls, data transfer controls, and entry logging per Annex II.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Not mentioned in any public-facing documentation.

security.name: Availability / SLA
security.value: SLA-backed support mentioned on homepage. Specific uptime SLA percentage not publicly stated.

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Data Breach Policy document exists (recruiterflow.com/data-breach-policy). Specific notification timelines could not be extracted from the PDF. GDPR 72-hour notification is required by DPA framework.

security.name: Sub-processors
security.value: EXHIBIT 3 of the DPA references a sub-processor list but it is not publicly disclosed in the DPA document itself.

products.name: Platform Plan
products.data_scope: Candidate profiles, contact data, job mandates, email and LinkedIn communications, call recordings (if AIRA Notetaker used). Handles special-category GDPR data (CVs, employment history, potentially Article 9 data).
products.notes: $149/user/month. Includes ATS, CRM, multichannel sequences, automation, API access, and basic reporting. No AIRA AI agents in this tier.

products.name: AIRA Plan
products.data_scope: All Platform Plan data plus AI-processed call transcripts, meeting summaries, auto-populated CRM fields, and sourced external candidate profiles (AIRA Source).
products.notes: Custom pricing for larger teams. Adds full AIRA agent suite: Notetaker, Matchmaker, Job Change Alerts, Field Updates Agent, Submission Agent, Task Agent, and agentic orchestration. AI data handling commitments are the key procurement question for this tier.

compare.pricing_model: Per-user per-month SaaS. Platform Plan at $149/user/month; AIRA Plan at custom pricing.
compare.data_residency: Not publicly disclosed. SCC/UK IDTA in DPA enables EU and UK data transfers but specific hosting regions are not stated.

flags: The homepage and DPA badge display 'SOC 2' without a type qualifier; only the May 2024 blog announcement explicitly confirms Type 1, and SOC 2 Type 2 (continuous audit) has not been announced. Read the certification as SOC 2 Type 1, not the stronger Type 2 audit.

There is no dedicated trust center: trust.recruiterflow.com, security.recruiterflow.com, and compliance.recruiterflow.com all redirect to the main marketing homepage, and the data-security page (recruiterflow.com/data-security) is unavailable. Security information is spread across the DPA, a blog post, and product pages rather than consolidated in one place.

Marketing claims 'no cross-account training or shared memory' for AIRA, but this commitment does not appear in the DPA or Privacy Policy text. Customers using the AI-heavy AIRA Plan should obtain explicit contractual AI data commitments.

Data residency is not documented: the DPA uses SCCs and the UK IDTA but does not name data center locations or regions, so customers with strict data sovereignty requirements (e.g., EU-only hosting) cannot confirm compliance from public documentation.

Recruiterflow handles candidate health data as a special category under GDPR Article 9 but has no stated HIPAA posture. Healthcare or healthcare-adjacent recruiters using this platform should confirm BAA availability separately.
